name: @echelon-foundry/design-system
description: Zero-runtime HTML and CSS design system for Echelon Foundry applications.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run tokens:build && npm run assets:build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:tokens && npm run test:runtime && npm run site:build:only && npm run site:test && npm run test:browser
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run site:build:only
scripts.site:check: npm run site:build && npm run site:test
scripts.site:serve: npm run site:build && python3 -m http.server 4000 -d site-dist
